items.name: tokens
items.title: MetalUI tokens
items.description: Soft Hardware colorways (bone, graphite), materials, caps and springs as --mu-* custom properties. Every component imports it.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: A press-in pill button. It sinks 1px into a well while held and springs back on release. It comes with standard, primary and destructive caps.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/button.md. SwiftUI: MetalButton in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: cue
items.title: Cue family
items.description: Recognition made visible on the text: date, duration, amount, measurement, tag, derived tag and hex cues that never move a letter; the URL host pill and the inferred pill; the dimple, ghost dimple and urgency LED in the margin; the trailing life glyph.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/cue.md. SwiftUI: MetalDimple, MetalCueURLPill, MetalCueInferred, MetalCueUrgency, MetalCueLife, Text.metalCue(_:) in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: hover-engraving
items.title: Hover engraving
items.description: A block's identity on a 420 ms dwell: a frosted pill beside its first line, engraved in the label role: kind, time, edits, other events, derived tags and the recognizer's status with an LED.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/hover-engraving.md. SwiftUI: MetalHoverEngraving in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: provenance-tooltip
items.title: Provenance tooltip
items.description: One hover away from every cue: a graphite tooltip on Base UI Tooltip that says where the cue came from (RULE · DATE PARSER, JEV · 0.82, YOU), with the number whenever the app guessed.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/provenance-tooltip.md. SwiftUI: MetalProvenanceTooltip, .metalProvenance(_:detail:) in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: region
items.title: Region
items.description: A drawn rectangle with a name that carries a rule: a sunk well with a head (name, rule, count), a drop-target state, dim and past states, renaming, and a pinned-lens form as a frosted plate with rows.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/region.md. SwiftUI: MetalRegion, MetalRegionRow in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: selection-frame
items.title: Selection frame
items.description: KAMUI-14, the one selection for every kind of object: a 1.25 green ring with a flat collar at offset 6, eight handles on the ring line, and a graphite readout of the measured frame. Hover shows only faint corner dots and an edge light.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/selection-frame.md. SwiftUI: MetalSelectionFrame in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: suggestion-chip
items.title: Suggestion chip
items.description: One question the recognizer asks at middle confidence, beside its block: the label, the confidence, and accept and dismiss buttons. Faint until the block is hovered.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/suggestion-chip.md. SwiftUI: MetalSuggestionChip in the MetalUI Swift package.
